def transform(grid):
    # The input is two side-by-side 4x4 symbol panels. Encode the position-wise
    # overlap of colors 6 and 5, with overlap marked as 4.
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    n = w // 2
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        row = []
        for c in range(n):
            left, right = grid[r][c], grid[r][c+n]
            row.append(4 if left == 6 and right == 5 else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
PY
